# Third-party: bench-scoreboard-adv (wave-4 slot 173)

No new dependencies and no copied code. `bench-scoreboard` already depended on `serde_json` (workspace, MIT OR
Apache-2.0, https://github.com/serde-rs/json); it is now also listed under `[dev-dependencies]` for the real CLI test
that tampers a score JSON. The merged branches document their own: docs/third-party/bench-banking-adv.md,
bench-ws-adv.md, bench-vending-adv.md.
